purpose: Resolve randomization-test tail and numerical details omitted from the original outcome-blind preregistration.
primary_randomization_p_value: greater-than-or-equal one-sided tail for a positive cohort-mean interior slope
direction_rationale: The prespecified recipient-to-donor dose hypothesis predicts increasing donor-directed action projection as alpha increases.
two_sided_sensitivity: also report the absolute-tail Monte Carlo p-value without replacing the primary directional test
state_slope_formula: sum((alpha-mean(alpha))*projection) / sum((alpha-mean(alpha))^2), using only the three interior points
projection_denominator: squared Euclidean distance between executed-action endpoint vectors A_1 and A_0
bootstrap_interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of unweighted state-resampled cohort means
undefined_endpoint_policy: fail the complete-cohort confirmatory analysis when any endpoint squared distance is exactly zero
